title: FrameMessage
description: gateway → vision. Metadata for one webcam frame. The JPEG bytes themselves are NOT embedded in this JSON: they travel as a separate binary part (Content-Type: image/jpeg). See docs/api-contract.md §Frame transport. This is the ONLY message in the system that is accompanied by image data.

content_type.description: MIME type of the accompanying binary payload.

captured_at_ms.description: Unix epoch ms when the browser captured the frame (browser clock). Used as the start point of e2e_ms.

received_at_ms.description: Unix epoch ms when gateway received the frame over WebSocket (gateway clock).

byte_length.description: Size of the JPEG payload in bytes (payload size metric).

jpeg_quality.description: Encoder quality used by the browser (0-100), if known.

mirrored.description: True if the browser horizontally flipped the image before encoding (selfie view).

schema_version.description: Contract version (semver). Major mismatch must be rejected.

trace_id.description: Per-frame trace identifier issued by gateway (UUID recommended). Preserved unchanged by every service.

session_id.description: Browser WebSocket session identifier issued by gateway.

frame_id.description: Monotonically increasing frame counter within a session (starts at 0).

timestamp_ms.description: Unix epoch ms when THIS message was created by its producer.
